### show full-configuration system global
config system global
    set admin-concurrent enable
    set admin-https-ssl-versions tlsv1-1 tlsv1-2 tlsv1-3
    set admin-port 80
    set admin-sport 443
    set admin-ssh-port 22
    set admin-ssh-v1 enable
    set hostname "FGT-LAB"
    set ssl-min-proto-version TLSv1-1
    set strong-crypto disable
    set timezone 04
end
### show full-configuration vpn ipsec phase1-interface
config vpn ipsec phase1-interface
    edit "to-branch-legacy"
        set type static
        set interface "wan1"
        set ike-version 1
        set authmethod psk
        set mode aggressive
        set peertype any
        set proposal des-md5 3des-sha1 aes128-sha256
        set dhgrp 2 5
        set remote-gw 198.51.100.7
        set psksecret ENC FIXTURE-NOT-A-SECRET
    next
    edit "to-dc"
        set type static
        set interface "wan1"
        set ike-version 2
        set authmethod signature
        set proposal aes256gcm-prfsha384 chacha20poly1305-prfsha256
        set dhgrp 20 21
        set remote-gw 203.0.113.9
    next
end
### show full-configuration vpn ipsec phase2-interface
config vpn ipsec phase2-interface
    edit "to-branch-legacy-p2"
        set phase1name "to-branch-legacy"
        set proposal 3des-md5 aes128-sha1
        set pfs enable
        set dhgrp 2
    next
    edit "to-dc-p2"
        set phase1name "to-dc"
        set proposal aes256gcm
        set pfs enable
        set dhgrp 20
    next
end
